statements.status_notes: SonarQube is not vulnerable to CVE-2025-48734. According to SonarQube's official CVE review (CVE-review-and-treatment-status-sqcb.csv), commons-beanutils is used only within integration test code samples and is not included in the final Java Analyzer runtime. The vulnerability requires external input to reach BeanUtils.getProperty() methods, but the library is isolated to test fixtures and sample code analysis.
